page: Google Cloud Platform ct3p-hightpu-4t is a specialized TPU-accelerated server instance designed for machine learning workloads. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 340 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.08 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on a single vNUMA node configuration.

The primary computational capability of this instance is driven by four integrated Google TPU v3 accelerators, delivering a combined total of 128 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. This hardware configuration does not include local storage, meaning all data persistence must rely on external network-attached storage volumes. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this instance.

Given the inclusion of four Google TPU v3 accelerators, this server is optimized for deep learning tasks, specifically large-scale model training and high-throughput inference. The high memory capacity of 340 GB supports large datasets in memory during training phases. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the integration of dedicated TPUs provides a highly specialized resource density for tensor operations compared to general-purpose CPU instances, though the lack of local storage requires careful architectural planning for data pipeline throughput.
